dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #Hehe, hey there, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Looks like my luck is pretty good today!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: It's awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: It sure beats sleeping out in the open when adventuring. Way better!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: You don't need to find a hole in a tree to rest in, and you don't have to worry about sneak attacks from monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Rocks crashing from the sky... Whopperflowers popping out of nowhere...

choices.text: You can come here and relax after your adventures.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I'm so lucky to have someone as nice as you as a partner!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Hehe, looks like I'll be bothering you a bunch from now on.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Nah, not at all... It's an adventure! They're always like this.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: With your concern, I already feel like my wounds aren't hurting anymore! Really!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Sure, lemme tell you all about my adventures!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Hmm... A few days ago, I found an oddly colored Berry during an adventure!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: It was really sweet, but...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you get the runs?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, diarrhea is nothing. I'm used to that.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: At first, there were a lot of colored lights, but then it felt like a lot of little people were dancing in my head.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I recovered quickly enough, but I regret not putting some in my bag...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I wanted to warn everyone to avoid eating that type of Berry.

choices.text: You're really considerate towards others, aren't you?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Aw... this is how it ought to be.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: So many people took care of me, so I gotta return the favor!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Oh, right! Remember to call me next time you go adventuring! With me around, you won't have to worry about those kinds of dangers at all!

choices.text: You need to be more careful yourself...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Thanks, but there are times when it doesn't matter how careful I am. It would be better to warn others instead.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: For us adventurers, what we want to do is adventure, naturally!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: To get the treasure at the end of the journey, or to take the first steps into the unknown...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: No, wait... What I want to say is that I want to become your helping hand!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Look, I might not have any physical talents, but I don't fear pain and can adapt to long battles!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I get injured a lot from accidents, so I'm really skilled at bandaging wounds!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Right... We've been traveling together for a while, haven't we...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: ...I've actually thought about this many times.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Of course, I'll keep to my mission, but I've got other personal interests outside of that, too.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I want to become someone you can trust and depend on.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: A companion through thick and thin, good times and bad...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: This time, I want to become your strength!

choices.text: You've always been an important companion of mine.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Oh... what's wrong with me? This is supposed to be a happy occasion.

choices.text: I'll share some of my good luck with you.
Why do you want to be my helping hand?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Well... that's because you're the adventurer I admire the most!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Bennett.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #Morning, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: A new day, a new adventure for us to embark on!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Bennett.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #Night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Getting enough sleep is vital for tomorrow's adventures! Remember not to stay up too late.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: You've got a top-notch tent here! And the knapsack on the floor is a limited edition that costs a ton of Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: ...If Benny's Adventure Team could deck everyone out with gear like this, then I wouldn't have to worry so much about recruiting members...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Ahahaha... I don't wanna put you out or anything...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: High-quality ores, a flawless workbench... and an enormous anvil and furnace!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Amazing! It's just as good as Mister Wagner's smithy! You could fix anything here!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Please, let me rent this place!
